name: @merit/ledger
description: Double-entry posting. A balanced posting is the only representable one: an entry exists only as one half of a transfer, so the legs of any posting sum to exactly zero by construction.
//: IT DECLARES NO WORKSPACE DEPENDENCY AND @merit/db's ABSENCE IS THE DESIGN RATHER THAN AN OMISSION, on packages/queue's own precedent. ADR-006's central consequence is that a posting commits in the SAME transaction as the state change that caused it, and a library able to reach a pool is a library that can open its own transaction and lose that consequence at every call site that forgets. `postTransaction` takes the caller's OPEN transaction as its FIRST argument with no overload that omits it, so this package cannot open a connection even by mistake. It also declares no `pg` and no `drizzle-orm`: `merit/no-raw-db-client` (VG-4) bans both here, and the ban is satisfiable precisely because the writer is injected. The cost is that `LedgerTx` RESTATES the subset of ADR-102's `SystemTx` this path uses, which is ADR-092 section 5's two-statements-of-one-fact hazard, and it is closed the only way it can be from here: the suite READS packages/db/src/scoped-db.ts and compares the two.
